name: RateGain Travel Technologies Ltd
tagline: India's largest travel & hospitality SaaS, already re-rated ~82% in a year to ~Rs 11,000 Cr, with only single-digit ROCE and modest organic growth
business_overview: RateGain is a SaaS provider to the global travel and hospitality industry -- distribution, rate intelligence and marketing technology for hotels, airlines and OTAs. Growth has been part acquisition-led.
fundamentals_table: Q2 FY26 revenue +9.7% QoQ; FY26 Q4 +175% YoY (acquisition-inflated)
fundamentals_narrative: Revenue growth is real but a good part is inorganic, and capital efficiency is low for a SaaS company (ROCE ~9%, ROE ~11-13%). The stock has already re-rated ~82% over the past year to ~Rs 11,000 Cr.
technical_read: Not pulled -- filtered on size, modest quality and an already-completed re-rating.
sentiment_summary: Not deep-read this pass. Filtered at the preliminary stage: a ~Rs 11,000 Cr mid-cap with single-digit ROCE, partly acquisition-driven growth and an 82% one-year run is a poor starting point for a 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years thesis, and no specific sharp catalyst is evident.
bull_case: Largest travel & hospitality SaaS franchise in India with a global client base
Recurring-revenue model with cross-sell across three product lines
bear_case: ~Rs 11,000 Cr market cap already, after an ~82% one-year re-rating
ROCE only ~9%, ROE ~11-13% -- weak for SaaS
No specific sharp catalyst to justify a multi-bagger call from here
verdict_headline: Quality franchise but already mid-cap, modest-return and re-rated -- filtered out on size and trajectory
verdict_reasoning: At ~Rs 11,000 Cr with ~9% ROCE and largely inorganic growth, a 10x/100x outcome is unrealistic
No red flag, but no sharp catalyst either -- filtered per the standard rule for a name that is both sizeable and only modestly profitable
Thesis fit 'neither', conviction Low, no revisit
